Geographies Served Programs Child Development Centre It employs various methods and therapies to detect and handle cases of disabilities in children providing online and home-based treatment services. All the cases are tracked through a development milestone tracker to access each child’s unique needs. It also works to provide assistive devices to introduce mobility into the child’s life. It partners with multiple NGOs to extend its reach to rural and remote areas. Sculpt Project Aims to enable children with disabilities to reach the level of other children by providing tools and methods to facilitate the special teaching and learning requirements of such children. Its contents feature learning resources, simple remedial learning techniques, availability in local languages, and online presence enabling access at school or home. Project LearnAbled The Foundation with an intent to arm youth with disabilities with employable skills runs more than 10 quick courses. The courses feature both technical and non-technical skills and are online, thus open to special youth from all over India to join and gain appropriate trades enabling them to attain employment and therefore sustenance. Project Swatantra This project strives to endow people with disabilities with livelihood options by skilling them in occupations like honey bee farming, mushroom, horticultural and vermicompost training, sewing, spice and incense stick making. It also attempts to develop and prepare trainers who can go forward and carry on the training process empowering more people with disabilities. Services The Foundation offers various services like training, employee engagement, consultations, audits and gifting ideas, keeping its core objective of creating a better living for people with disabilities in view and helping organisations make their employees and premises more disabled-friendly. Impact Metrics Number of Lives Impacted With Health, Education and Livelihood Year-wise Metrics 2019-20 5281 2020-21 1846 2021-22 3488 Participants in Awareness Camps for Parents, Government and Corporate Staff Year-wise Metrics 2020-21 5794 2021-22 4245 Milestones & Track Record GiftAbled has successfully implemented projects like Svastya (health initiative), Sculpt (e-learning for children), LearnAbled (skill development), and Swatantra (livelihood generation), while also deploying its programs at institutions like the United States Air Force Academy and the US Marine Corps Center for Advanced Operational Culture and Learning. --> --> Leadership Team Prarthana Kaul Co-Founder & Managing Trustee Prateek Kaul Co-Founder & Trustee Deekshitha Ramesh Associate Vice President Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AACTG0169J Registration Number BDH-4-00292-2013-14 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2017/0117846 --> 80G AACTG0169JF20214 12A AACTG0169JE20214 FCRA 94421770 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2013 Demographies Served Specially Abled --> Impact The GiftAbled Foundation has reached more than 8,796 beneficiaries with 27,246 plus participants and more than 6,281 volunteers. Vision and Mission GiftAbled's vision is to build an inclusive world where People with Disabilities find equal opportunity in all aspects of life, while its mission is to innovate and accelerate inclusion to transform the lives of People with Disabilities.
